$comment: Stand-in brand theme: S2A's values under Spectrum's token names. Evaluation only. Every entry says why it exists. Use the first kind that does the job.

overrides.name: neutral-background-color-default
overrides.reason: S2A's solid button is pure black, and gray-1000 flips to white in dark as S2A does.

overrides.name: neutral-background-color-hover
overrides.reason: S2A's solid hover is translucent, which no Spectrum step gives in both modes.

overrides.name: accent-background-color-default
overrides.reason: S2A keeps blue-900 in both modes.

overrides.name: accent-background-color-hover
overrides.reason: S2A keeps blue-1000 in both modes.

overrides.name: accent-background-color-down
overrides.reason: S2A accent active is a step Spectrum's ramp does not have.

overrides.name: focus-indicator-color
overrides.reason: S2A's focus ring differs from Spectrum's in both modes.

overrides.name: default-font-family
overrides.reason: adobe.com uses Adobe Clean, not Adobe Clean Spectrum VF. Ends in sans-serif so a device without Adobe Clean gets a sans-serif, not the browser default.

newTokens.name: theme-button-padding-inline
newTokens.reason: S2A's button is wider than any Spectrum base padding.

newTokens.name: theme-button-padding-block
newTokens.reason: S2A's button is taller than Spectrum's medium.

newTokens.name: theme-button-outline-hover
newTokens.reason: S2A's outlined hover is translucent and works on any ground.

newTokens.name: theme-button-outline-border
newTokens.reason: S2A outlined border is pure black, white in dark. Role token so other themes can set their own.

newTokens.name: theme-button-radius
newTokens.reason: border/radius/999 in S2A. Spectrum derives its pill from the height token, so wider padding breaks it.

newTokens.name: theme-button-outline-border-hover
newTokens.reason: S2A does not change the border on hover.

notApplied.what: S2A dims a disabled button with opacity 48%. Spectrum swaps to disabled color tokens.
notApplied.why: A different mechanism, not a different value. Needs a design decision, so the stand-in keeps Spectrum's.

notApplied.what: S2A's outlined active fills solid and flips the label.
notApplied.why: Needs a coordinated pair of bindings. Left out to keep the stand-in small; expressible with two more bindings.

notApplied.what: S2A has no mobile values for its button.
notApplied.why: Mobile falls through to Spectrum, except the new padding tokens, which are desktop only.

styleMap.decision: Owner, 2026-11-06: map to staticColor for now, check with design.
